articles.title: North Korean Hackers Steal Developer Credentials to Inject Malware Into GitHub and Software Packages
articles.summary:
A North Korea-aligned hacking group has moved beyond fake job interviews and now steals developer credentials to plant malware in trusted software projects. The group, tracked as DeceptiveDevelopment, used the stolen access to change code in public and private repositories between April and September 2026. Every poisoned project then became a new way into the […]

articles.title: APT Hackers Use NetamLoader Malware to Target Windows 10 Systems in Asian Governments
articles.summary:
A new malware framework called NetamLoader is being used against a custom version of Windows 10 that only government bodies in Asia use. The campaign looks like a supply-chain operation, and nobody has linked it to a known hacking group yet. The malware hides inside a Windows update package, borrows trusted software to run, and […]

articles.title: Aur0ra Ransomware Hackers Use Cursor AI Agents to Gain Domain Admin Access and Steal Data
articles.summary:
Ransomware crews are now giving the hardest parts of a network break-in to AI coding tools. A group linked to Aur0ra ransomware used Cursor AI agents to go from stolen passwords to domain admin access, the highest level of control in a Windows network. From there, it collected data and prepared to deploy ransomware. The […]

articles.title: Hackers Build Fake Polymarket Platforms That Rig Trades and Block Cryptocurrency Withdrawals
articles.summary:
Criminals are copying the look of Polymarket, one of the biggest prediction market sites. They use the copies to take cryptocurrency from people who think they are placing real bets. Once a victim deposits money, the site decides every win and loss, and withdrawals stop working. The scams are not one-off websites. Three Russian-speaking “traffer” […]

articles.title: Critical Drupal Commerce Vulnerability Could Let Hackers Buy Products for Just $0.01
articles.summary:
Drupal has warned that hackers are actively exploiting a highly critical security flaw in Commerce Core, putting online stores at risk of financial losses. Tracked as CVE-2026-118539, the vulnerability lets attackers bypass access checks in the module used to sell products and services on Drupal websites and connected shopping applications. articles.title: Hackers Exploit Passwordless Telnet to Infect Linux Devices With New Kairos DDoS Botnet
articles.summary:
A new botnet called Kairos is spreading to Linux devices through a very old mistake: a Telnet service that accepts the root user with no password. Once inside, the attackers install a small Go-based program that turns the device into a node for DDoS operations. The campaign shows that basic security gaps still give attackers […]

articles.title: Hackers Use Zero-Click Coruna and DarkSword Exploits to Steal Sensitive Data From iPhones
articles.summary:
Hackers are using two powerful iPhone exploit kits, Coruna and DarkSword, to break into phones and steal private data. The victim only has to open a web page. There is no app to install and no prompt to accept. The scale is larger than many people expected. Researchers found 608 domains delivering Coruna-family code. These […]

articles.title: Hackers Weaponize OpenAI API in NIK C2 Framework for Credential Theft and Remote System Control
articles.summary:
A new malware framework called NIK C2 is turning the OpenAI API into a tool for cybercriminals. Its Windows implant can dump passwords, record every keystroke, take hidden control of a desktop, and send the stolen data to an AI model for analysis, all inside the same session. articles.title: Researchers Hacked Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, VS Code, and Claude Desktop Embedded Browsers
articles.summary:
Security flaws in the embedded browsers of Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, VS Code, and Claude Desktop could enable code execution, file theft, and address-bar spoofing on developer machines. The findings published on October 29 show how browser features built into AI assistants can break security boundaries when given extra access to their host apps. The […]
